Safe Harbor by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Set in the heart of WaterColor, Safe Harbor is a five-bedroom, four–and–a–half–bath home, with space to spread out. It’s equal parts polished retreat and easygoing beach base, with five bikes ready to roll. WaterColor is stunning, so let the adventures roll, right outside your front porch. The neighborhood’s gorgeous trails, pools, and paths are waiting for you and your crew. The spacious front porch and ample outdoor seating create a warm welcome for guests arriving at 47 Red Cedar Way. Inside, the ample spaces are designed for together time that never feels crowded.

Plush furnishings and a mounted, flat-screen television make the living area a relaxing place to unwind after a long day of fun and sun. The kitchen is well equipped for everything from laid-back breakfasts to full family dinners, with seating for eight at the table and a few extra spots at the bar. The first-floor primary suite keeps things convenient, featuring a king bed and a spacious bath with soaking tub and separate shower. Upstairs, two guest rooms with queen beds and private baths sit alongside a bunk room built just for younger guests. For guests seeking extra privacy, the carriage house above the garage offers a primary suite with its own bathroom, creating a perfect retreat within the retreat. WaterColor’s calm, polished atmosphere surrounds it all, making Safe Harbor a smart choice for a refined (and fun!) 30A stay that never feels overdone. For a delighful mix of tranquility and luxury, book your stay at Safe Harbor today. Overview: - 1 mile to beach and Beach Club (private access) - 5 bedrooms, 4.5 baths - 2,332 sq ft - Access to WaterColor community pools and beach club - Limited onsite parking, minimal community parking with pass - No garage access - Gas grill - Wi-Fi - 5 bikes included Overnight FIRST FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath with shower/tub combo SECOND FLOOR - Guest Room: Queen bed, private bath, shower/tub combo - Guest Room: Queen bed, with twin sleeper, shared bath, shower/tub combo - Bunk Room: Two twin-over-twin built-in bunk beds, shared bath CARRIAGE HOUSE: - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, shower/tub combo Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
